title: Fema / RBI | RBI Invites Public Comments on Draft On-Tap Licensing Framework for Urban Co-operative Banks
description: Fema / RBIRBI has released draft guidelines for on-tap licensing of Urban Co-operative Banks and invited public comments until 05 September 2026.The post RBI Invites Public Comments on Draft On-Tap Licensing Framework for Urban Co-operative Banks appeared first on TaxGuru.
